summary: Expanded the direct public-company universe for lower-tier defense subcontractor exposure. The best-fit names in this pass are not prime contractors; they are mission electronics, aerostructures, test systems, and specialty materials suppliers whose revenue/backlog ties into defense primes, military aircraft, missiles, space, and government-funded programs. Node-level evidence supports the chokepoint premise: DoD and primes lose visibility below tier 2, while small subtier suppliers face appropriation delays, tariff paperwork, qualification burdens, and single/limited-source risks. This is research support only, not a trading recommendation.
